summary: Energy Transfer LP filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (424B5) on November 5, 2026 for a three-tranche senior unsecured notes offering: 2032, 2037 and 2057 maturities, with principal amounts, coupons and prices left blank pending pricing. Interest is semi-annual from 2026, with make-whole calls before each par call date (one, three and six months pre-maturity). Notes are unguaranteed at issuance but future long-term-debt guarantors must guarantee; ranking is pari passu with existing senior unsecured debt ahead of subordinated debt. Joint bookrunners include Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Morgan Stanley, RBC and Wells Fargo. This is an ordinary debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch final coupon, size and use of proceeds.
